responsibility: Declares the `Parser` class and the full set of recursive-descent parsing entry points for D source. It exposes methods for parsing modules, declarations, attributes, templates, statements, expressions, types, initializers, imports, aggregates, contracts, and inline constructs, along with parser-state fields and the operator-precedence definitions used by the lexer/parser layer.
same_name_distinction: Declares the Parser class, parse entry points, statement-parsing flags, and precedence enums/externs; unlike parse.c, it provides the interface and parser state layout rather than the parsing logic itself.
